products.name: Physical Intelligence (pi0)
products.note: General-purpose robot AI; physical task learning; safety-critical; emerging governance standards

profile_text.body:
Physical Intelligence is a company developing learning algorithms intended to enable general-purpose AI control of robots across a wide range of physical tasks. The team describes itself as composed of engineers, scientists, roboticists, and company builders, and frames its mission as bringing general-purpose AI into the physical world.

The company has released two generalist robot policies. The first, π0, is described as a prototype model that combines large-scale multi-task and multi-robot data collection with a new network architecture, which the company characterizes as the most capable and dexterous generalist robot policy to date. Its successor, π0.5, extends π0 with what the company calls open-world generalization, demonstrated through a mobile manipulator performing cleanup tasks in previously unseen kitchens and bedrooms.

The site's held facts list π0 under the Emerging and Frontier AI category, noting its relevance to physical task learning, safety-critical applications, and emerging governance standards. No litigation, SEC filings, or patent records are present in the available data.
